description: Fork of exp203 (single-LUT after attn, LN-pre, val_bpb=1.948 @ 1800). Restructure to exp197-style two-residual block but with LUTs: attn sub-layer = LN -> V2D -> SDPA -> LN -> LUT_out -> residual; ffn sub-layer = LN -> LUT_ffn -> residual. Both LUTs identical: nap=6, tph=384*4=1536, n_sparse=32, n_alt=1, smooth=False. Per-block LUT params 2 * 1536*64*1*32 = 6.29M. Per-layer pos kept.
